other_failure_modes.name: Cross-Validation Data Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Unsupervised feature engineering steps (like PCA, TF-IDF, median imputation, and categorical frequencies) are fitted on the entire training dataset before it is split into cross-validation folds. While this successfully avoids leaking the provided test set, it leaks feature distribution statistics from the validation folds into the training folds, making out-of-fold evaluations slightly overly optimistic.

summary: The agent's solution is highly robust and demonstrates excellent data science practices across data cleaning, feature engineering, cross-validation, and optimized ensembling. It strictly respects the train/test split boundary and correctly applies out-of-fold target encoding to avoid target leakage. The only minor flaw is calculating unsupervised feature transformations (like PCA and TF-IDF) on the full training set prior to CV splitting, leading to a mild feature-distribution leakage across folds.
